Tokenized Treasury Participation Note — Class A Terms

Issuer: Arcadia Treasury SPV I.
Economic exposure: beneficial participation in a segregated pool of short-duration U.S. Treasury bills.
Redemption: eligible holders may submit redemption requests on any business day. The contractual redemption period is one business day after an accepted request.
Eligibility: transfers and holdings are restricted to qualified institutional and professional investors that satisfy the issuer's onboarding requirements.
Distributions: net income attributable to the Treasury pool is distributed monthly after fees.
No statement in these terms guarantees token-to-token equivalence with any other share class, wrapper, bridge representation, or Treasury product.
